  (() => {
    const root = document.getElementById('eb');

    const sctx = snowCv.getContext('2d');
    const pctx = sparkCv.getContext('2d');
    const reduced = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    const DPR = Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);

    let W = 0, H = 0;
    function size() {
      const r = root.getBoundingClientRect();
      W = r.width; H = r.height;
      for (const [cv, c] of [[snowCv, sctx], [sparkCv, pctx]]) {
        cv.width = Math.round(W * DPR); cv.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
        c.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
      }
    }

    /* ---------- falling snow (behind the cards, so it shows on the oxblood) ---------- */
    const snow = [], sparks = [];
    const flakeCount = () => Math.max(30, Math.min(90, Math.round(W * H / 16000)));
    function flake(anyY) {
      return { x: rand(0, W), y: anyY ? rand(0, H) : -6,
               r: rand(.7, 1.9), v: rand(10, 26), ph: rand(0, 6.28), a: rand(.25, .6) };
    }
    function fillSnow() { snow.length = 0; for (let i = 0, n = flakeCount(); i < n; i++) snow.push(flake(true)); }

    function starPath(c, x, y, s) {
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(x, y - s * 2); c.lineTo(x + s * .35, y - s * .35); c.lineTo(x + s * 2, y);
      c.lineTo(x + s * .35, y + s * .35); c.lineTo(x, y + s * 2); c.lineTo(x - s * .35, y + s * .35);
      c.lineTo(x - s * 2, y); c.lineTo(x - s * .35, y - s * .35); c.closePath(); c.fill();
    }

          const f = snow[i];
